cht_CheckCheat :: proc(cht: ^cheatseq_t, key: u8) -> int {
	rc := 0

	if cht_firsttime != 0 {
		cht_firsttime = 0
		for i := 0; i < 256; i += 1 {
			a := u8(i)
			cheat_xlate_table[i] = ((a & 1) << 7) | ((a & 2) << 5) | (a & 4) | ((a & 8) << 1) | ((a & 16) >> 1) | (a & 32) | ((a & 64) >> 5) | ((a & 128) >> 7)
		}
	}

	if cht.p == nil {
		cht.p = cht.sequence
	}

	if cht.p[0] == 0 {
		cht.p[0] = key
		cht.p = &cht.p[1]
	} else if cheat_xlate_table[key] == cht.p[0] {
		cht.p = &cht.p[1]
	} else {
		cht.p = cht.sequence
	}

	if cht.p[0] == 1 {
		cht.p = &cht.p[1]
	} else if cht.p[0] == 0xff {
		cht.p = cht.sequence
		rc = 1
	}

	return rc
}

cht_GetParam :: proc(cht: ^cheatseq_t, buffer: [^]u8) {
	p := cht.sequence
	for {
		v := p[0]
		p = &p[1]
		if v == 1 {
			break
		}
	}

	b := buffer
	for {
		c := p[0]
		b[0] = c
		b = &b[1]
		p[0] = 0
		p = &p[1]
		if c == 0 || p[0] == 0xff {
			break
		}
	}

	if p[0] == 0xff {
		b[0] = 0
	}
}

WritePCXfile :: proc(filename: cstring, data_in: [^]byte, width: int, height: int, palette_in: [^]byte) {
	data := data_in
	palette := palette_in
	pcx := (^pcx_t)(Z_Malloc(width * height * 2 + 1000, PU_STATIC, nil))

	pcx.manufacturer = 0x0a
	pcx.version = 5
	pcx.encoding = 1
	pcx.bits_per_pixel = 8
	pcx.xmin = 0
	pcx.ymin = 0
	pcx.xmax = u16(SHORT(i16(width - 1)))
	pcx.ymax = u16(SHORT(i16(height - 1)))
	pcx.hres = u16(SHORT(i16(width)))
	pcx.vres = u16(SHORT(i16(height)))
	libc.memset(&pcx.palette[0], 0, 48)
	pcx.color_planes = 1
	pcx.bytes_per_line = u16(SHORT(i16(width)))
	pcx.palette_type = u16(SHORT(2))
	libc.memset(&pcx.filler[0], 0, 58)

	pack := ([^]byte)(&pcx.data)

	for i := 0; i < width * height; i += 1 {
		if (data[0] & 0xc0) != 0xc0 {
			pack[0] = data[0]
			pack = &pack[1]
			data = &data[1]
		} else {
			pack[0] = 0xc1
			pack = &pack[1]
			pack[0] = data[0]
			pack = &pack[1]
			data = &data[1]
		}
	}

	pack[0] = 0x0c
	pack = &pack[1]
	for i := 0; i < 768; i += 1 {
		pack[0] = palette[0]
		pack = &pack[1]
		palette = &palette[1]
	}

	length := int(uintptr(pack) - uintptr(pcx))
	M_WriteFile(filename, pcx, length)
	Z_Free(pcx)

				P_RemoveActiveCeiling(ceiling)
			case .silentCrushAndRaise:
				S_StartSound(&ceiling.sector.soundorg, int(sfxenum_t.sfx_pstop))
				ceiling.direction = -1
			case .fastCrushAndRaise, .crushAndRaise:

	case -1:
		res := T_MovePlane(ceiling.sector, ceiling.speed, ceiling.bottomheight, ceiling.crush, 1, ceiling.direction)

		if (leveltime & 7) == 0 {
			#partial switch ceiling.type {
			case .silentCrushAndRaise:
			case:
				S_StartSound(&ceiling.sector.soundorg, int(sfxenum_t.sfx_stnmov))
			}

			case .crushAndRaise:

				ceiling.direction = 1
			case .fastCrushAndRaise:
				ceiling.direction = 1
			case .lowerAndCrush, .lowerToFloor:
				P_RemoveActiveCeiling(ceiling)
			}
		} else {
			if res == .crushed {
				#partial switch ceiling.type {
				case .silentCrushAndRaise, .crushAndRaise, .lowerAndCrush:
					ceiling.speed = CEILSPEED / 8
				}
			}
		}

EV_DoCeiling :: proc(line: ^line_t, type: ceiling_e) -> int {
	secnum := -1
	rtn := 0

	#partial switch type {
	case .fastCrushAndRaise, .silentCrushAndRaise, .crushAndRaise:
		P_ActivateInStasisCeiling(line)
	}

	for {
		secnum = P_FindSectorFromLineTag(line, secnum)
		if secnum < 0 {
			break
		}
		sec := &sectors[secnum]
		if sec.specialdata != nil {
			continue
		}

		rtn = 1
		ceiling := (^ceiling_t)(Z_Malloc(size_of(ceiling_t), PU_LEVSPEC, nil))
		P_AddThinker(&ceiling.thinker)
		sec.specialdata = ceiling
		ceiling.thinker.function.acp1 = T_MoveCeiling
		ceiling.sector = sec
		ceiling.crush = false

		switch type {
		case .fastCrushAndRaise:
			ceiling.crush = true
			ceiling.topheight = sec.ceilingheight
			ceiling.bottomheight = sec.floorheight + (8 * FRACUNIT)
			ceiling.direction = -1
			ceiling.speed = CEILSPEED * 2
		case .silentCrushAndRaise, .crushAndRaise:
			ceiling.crush = true
			ceiling.topheight = sec.ceilingheight
			ceiling.bottomheight = sec.floorheight + (8 * FRACUNIT)
			ceiling.direction = -1
			ceiling.speed = CEILSPEED
		case .lowerAndCrush, .lowerToFloor:
			ceiling.bottomheight = sec.floorheight
			if type != .lowerToFloor {
				ceiling.bottomheight += 8 * FRACUNIT
			}
			ceiling.direction = -1
			ceiling.speed = CEILSPEED
		case .raiseToHighest:
			ceiling.topheight = P_FindHighestCeilingSurrounding(sec)
			ceiling.direction = 1
			ceiling.speed = CEILSPEED
		}

		ceiling.tag = int(sec.tag)
		ceiling.type = type
		P_AddActiveCeiling(ceiling)
	}
	return rtn

		if activeceilings[i] == c {
			activeceilings[i].sector.specialdata = nil

		P_SetMobjState(target, target.info.xdeathstate)
	} else {
		P_SetMobjState(target, target.info.deathstate)

P_DamageMobj :: proc(target: ^mobj_t, inflictor: ^mobj_t, source: ^mobj_t, damage_in: int) {
	damage := damage_in
	if (target.flags & MF_SHOOTABLE) == 0 {
		return
	}

	if target.health <= 0 {
		return
	}

	if (target.flags & MF_SKULLFLY) != 0 {
		target.momx = 0
		target.momy = 0
		target.momz = 0
	}

	player := target.player
	if player != nil && gameskill == .sk_baby {
		damage >>= 1
	}

	if inflictor != nil && (target.flags & MF_NOCLIP) == 0 && (source == nil || source.player == nil || source.player.readyweapon != .wp_chainsaw) {
		ang := R_PointToAngle2(inflictor.x, inflictor.y, target.x, target.y)

		thrust := fixed_t(damage * (FRACUNIT >> 3) * 100 / target.info.mass)

		if damage < 40 && damage > target.health && target.z - inflictor.z > 64 * FRACUNIT && (P_Random() & 1) != 0 {
			ang += ANG180
			thrust *= 4
		}

		ang >>= ANGLETOFINESHIFT
		target.momx += FixedMul(thrust, finecosine[ang])
		target.momy += FixedMul(thrust, finesine[ang])
	}

	if player != nil {
		if target.subsector.sector.special == 11 && damage >= target.health {
			damage = target.health - 1
		}

		if damage < 1000 && ((player.cheats & CF_GODMODE) != 0 || player.powers[pw_invulnerability] != 0) {
			return
		}

		if player.armortype != 0 {
			saved: int
			if player.armortype == 1 {
				saved = damage / 3
			} else {
				saved = damage / 2
			}

			if player.armorpoints <= saved {
				saved = player.armorpoints
				player.armortype = 0
			}
			player.armorpoints -= saved
			damage -= saved
		}
		player.health -= damage
		if player.health < 0 {
			player.health = 0
		}

		player.attacker = source
		player.damagecount += damage

		if player.damagecount > 100 {
			player.damagecount = 100
		}

		temp := damage < 100 ? damage : 100

		if player == &players[consoleplayer] {
			I_Tactile(40, 10, 40 + temp * 2)
		}
	}

	target.health -= damage
	if target.health <= 0 {
		P_KillMobj(source, target)
		return
	}

	if P_Random() < target.info.painchance && (target.flags & MF_SKULLFLY) == 0 {
		target.flags |= MF_JUSTHIT
		P_SetMobjState(target, target.info.painstate)
	}

	target.reactiontime = 0

	if (target.threshold == 0 || target.type == .MT_VILE) && source != nil && source != target && source.type != .MT_VILE {
		target.target = source
		target.threshold = BASETHRESHOLD
		if target.state == &states[target.info.spawnstate] && target.info.seestate != .S_NULL {
			P_SetMobjState(target, target.info.seestate)
		}
	}

	thing.ceilingz = tmceilingz

	thing.y = y

		return

	side := P_PointOnLineSide(slidemo.x, slidemo.y, ld)

	lineangle := R_PointToAngle2(0, 0, ld.dx, ld.dy)

	if side == 1 {
		lineangle += ANG180
	}

	moveangle := R_PointToAngle2(0, 0, tmxmove, tmymove)
	deltaangle := moveangle - lineangle

	if deltaangle > ANG180 {
		deltaangle += ANG180

	lineangle >>= ANGLETOFINESHIFT
	deltaangle >>= ANGLETOFINESHIFT

	movelen := P_AproxDistance(tmxmove, tmymove)
	newlen := FixedMul(movelen, finecosine[deltaangle])

	tmymove = FixedMul(newlen, finesine[lineangle])

		if P_PointOnLineSide(slidemo.x, slidemo.y, li) != 0 {

		isblocking = true

			isblocking = true
		} else {

		}

	if in_ptr.frac < bestslidefrac {
		secondslidefrac = bestslidefrac
